children: Sept 17 (Reuters) - Foreign investors bought a net C$20.65 billion ($14.76 billion) in Canadian securities in July, led by federal government bonds, following an upwardly revised C$41.25 billion total purchase in June, Statistics Canada said on Thursday.   Canadian investors sold a net C$30.63 billion worth of foreign securities, led by a record divestment of U.S. shares, as well as U.S. government bonds to a lesser extent.
